description: `multiverse board --no-reconcile` renders an UNRECORDED task — status file written (role=librarian, an old pre-rename dispatch role name) but no event=result line in routing.log yet, e.g. the dispatch process died or raced ahead of the agent — as an IN PROGRESS card with the generic 'unrecorded, needs --reconcile' note. `--no-reconcile` only opts out of *writing* a reconciled outcome; board still makes its one `agent list` call to render live state, in both Python and Rust, so the transcript cannot be empty — it scripts that one call with a malformed (non-JSON) reply, the same 'herdr answered but untrustworthy' shape `workers-malformed-herdr-json.json` uses, so `live_agents` comes back `None` (herdr unreachable/untrustworthy) rather than an empty-but-trustworthy listing. tasks.resolve only reaches the generic wording when live_agents is None — when herdr answers with a trustworthy (if empty) listing, an UNRECORDED task whose recorded pane is absent from it instead gets the more specific 'pane gone, status done' reason and a BLOCKED card, a different, equally real history-reading case this scenario does not also cover. A genuinely RECORDED (done/failed) task is dropped from the board entirely (board.py's _split_dispatched) — not asserted here since it would render nothing, but worth knowing before trusting an absence on the board as 'nothing happened'.
